Thanks for the clear list. Below is how we can support and a recommended timeline for the attendees from Redwood + external consultants. I attached a draft invitation for your review.

What Redwood will provide:
- Signed corporate invitation letter (PDF) on Redwood letterhead; includes: attendee name, passport number, travel dates, purpose ("enterprise workshop, product demos, partnership meetings"), and a short program outline.

Courier: DHL Express or local same-day couriers are fine; include return tracking and a power-of-attorney form if courier requires. Redwood prefers DHL for consistency — we’ll cover the outbound courier for the documents we mail.

Thanks Evelyn, Anika — quick local update from the embassy side and courier logistics: 

- Kenyan embassy (Nairobi consular) recommends originals for any non-East African passports. They accept scanned letters for pre-evaluation but final stamping often wants originals.
- Typical appointment slots are currently 3–4 weeks out; with a good invitation + courier proof we can sometimes get an earlier slot (1–2 weeks) but that depends on peak season.
- Suggested courier workflow: sender sends via DHL Express (document only), recipient returns passport via DHL same-day (Kenya domestic network) or national courier if outside Nairobi.

I attached a local checklist we share with clients — it includes embassy address, prefilled document labels, and a sample POA format for courier pickup.

If you want me to handle local pickup/hand-delivery of the original to the consular desk, I can — fee-based.

Regards,
Ken Otieno
Kenya Consulting — Travel & Visa Services
